ns2:course.label: Music in Adolescence
ns2:course.description: Detailed consideration of the general music program in both middle school and high school. Emphasis on adolescent characteristics and alternative methods of instruction. Prerequisite: Restricted to Music Education majors or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Restricted to Music Education majors or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to BME:Mus Ed:Choral Music-UIUC, BME:MusEd:Instrmntl Music-UIUC, BME:Mus Ed:Elem Gen Music-UIUC, or MME:Music Education -UIUC.
